notes.title: 🎃 Halloween Demo Update — Play Now! 🎃
notes.content:
[h1]Happy Halloween, puzzlers! ːsteamhappyː [/h1]

You know it’s Halloween time when the leaves have fallen, everyone drinks pumpkin spice latte and your neighborhood looks like a scary Doors level — vampire houses, spiderwebs everywhere, black cats and a creepy goat head that came straight from your nightmares.
Take out your candy bag, because boy do we have a treat for you!


[h3]For the whole month of Spooktober all the way till 4th of November, Doors: Paradox will treat the horror enthusiasts with a spoopy Halloween demo, which features:
[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]A vampire mansion riddled with mysteries[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41617316/f89db21b9d9eb3bf2cf12f3fbdbc6aa5155c636b.gif[/img]

[*][b] A spiritual séance in the middle of a cemetery[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41617316/884e5aa977fd328b9314fd8303f7830a42b8b286.gif[/img]

[*] [b]The tormented souls of a creepy mental asylum[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41617316/0cb7c48039c0d7ba98de7b78acc2c7b3a5020c63.gif[/img]

[*] [b]A spider lair entangled with the voices of the past[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41617316/8a4de484c2582d67f756277e85c8133c1eb5d677.gif[/img]

[*] [b]13 Languages localization[/b]
[/list]
[h3]and most importantly, a little witch hat for our favorite cat Zula. ːsteamhappyː [/h3]

notes.title: A Doors Journey + GIVEAWAY
notes.content:
Hey there!
Steam’s Next Fest is here, which means we will be streaming all week long

Without further ado, here are the stream levels you can watch right now:
[list]
[*] Toxic Tales
[*] Murder Motel
[*] Infernal Fire
[*] Arrow & Sword
[*] Pirate Bay
[*] Asian Fall
[/list]
The stream is going to be the perfect combination of demo levels you have already seen AND [b]3 brand new exclusive levels[/b] from the full game. Speaking of the demo, it is playable right now and as much as we love watching someone play, playing it yourself is a MUST in our book ;)

Now comes the fun part — we’re doing a [b]Giveaway!! [/b]Join the stream to find out how you can win free keys for Doors: Paradox when we release it.. 
Of course, if you enjoyed the stream and are interested to see more from Doors: Paradox don’t forget to wishlist it, so you can get a notification when we release it!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1622770/Doors_Paradox/][img]https://media.giphy.com/media/IKSwDT1pU1rrHtYanD/giphy.gif[/img][/url]
